summary: After the whole room agrees on {design}, the chair still asks everyone to turn in a score.
realLife: Once members unanimously recommended the Chisholm medal, Peter van Alfen asked them to send their individual scores to James Kennedy.
gates: A voice vote has concluded and members have individual score sheets.
inGame: needs: recorded voice vote and individual score sheets.

turns.what: One score sheet comes in after the meeting.
turns.pulledBy: A member left before sending it.
turns.writesBack: The clerk records which sheet is outstanding.

turns.what: The sheets show a wide split beneath a unanimous vote.
turns.pulledBy: Members supported the package for different reasons.
turns.writesBack: The score table accompanies the motion.
